notes.title: V1.3.0 Added Steam Cloud Saves
notes.content:
Steam Cloud Saves supported
Steam Dynamic Cloud Sync supported
When playing on your Steam Deck you can easily continue playing on your PC
The game now pauses when you open the Steam Overlay

notes.title: V1.2.0 Achievements Added
notes.content:
Five achievements have been added:

Complete levels 1-10
Complete levels 11-20
Complete levels 21-30
Complete levels 31-40
Complete the game

If your current save file shows you have accomplished these achievements you will automatically receive them.
